text: No, I cannot confirm there were *no* thermal detections for the full period. While there were *zero detections intersecting the asset* (ASSET-F14) during the period 2026-10-13 to 2026-11-12, the coverage was incomplete due to a gap in VIIRS_SNPP data from 2026-11-02 to 2026-11-06. This means that while no detections were recorded where they could be observed, the asset was not continuously monitored for the entire period due to the sensor gap. The other sensors (VIIRS_NOAA20, VIIRS_NOAA21, and MODIS) provided continuous coverage.
